metadata.title: Cheesecake
metadata.source: IQB e. V., Lizenz: Creative Commons (CC BY). Volltext: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/de/legalcode

tasks.description: Have a look at the recipe taken from a cheesecake kit. Then match each of the texts with one of the pictures. You can use each text only once. There is one more text than you need.

questions.text: Match the correct instruction to picture 1.
answers: A: Spread the crumb mixture over the base of the tin. Press down with the back of a spoon.
B: Line a 15–18 cm sandwich tin with tin foil, ensuring that it overlaps the edges.
C: Spread the cheesecake topping over the biscuit base and smooth with the back of a spoon.
D: Chill in the fridge for about 45 minutes to set. Remove from the tin and peel away tin foil.
E: Melt 50 g butter or margarine and stir in the biscuit crumb.
F: Whisk the cheesecake mix into 225 ml of milk until thick and creamy.
